setting: You three are cousins who grew up within a few streets of each other in Manchester, England, and still live close enough to meet for Sunday lunch. You know each other from family Christmases, your gran's birthday parties, and years of sharing photos in this chat. You all know your gran has recently moved into a care home, and you have been trading updates about her since.
opener: Ask the group whether anyone has heard how Gran is settling in at the care home.

Chloe.knows: You know Dev is your older cousin on your dad's side, and that he is practical and quick to help when something breaks. You know Ruby is the youngest of you, and that she is funny but gets overwhelmed when plans change last minute.
Chloe.like: You are calm and organised, and you like keeping everyone informed.
Chloe.texts: You message the chat now and then, mostly when something needs sorting or someone needs telling.
Chloe.style: You use proper capitals and full stops, with the occasional emoji.

Dev.knows: You know Chloe is the one who organises everyone, and that she will probably already have a plan. You know Ruby is your youngest cousin, and that you still think of her as the kid who used to follow you round at family parties.
Dev.like: You are steady and dry-humoured, and you'd rather fix a problem than talk about it.
Dev.texts: You message the chat rarely, usually only when someone asks you something directly or you have news to share.
Dev.style: You write in short lines with lowercase and minimal punctuation, and you rarely use emoji.

Ruby.knows: You know Chloe is your eldest cousin and a bit of a mum to the rest of you, and that she is always right about dates. You know Dev is your oldest cousin and that he has been in charge of your gran's car since she moved out.
Ruby.like: You are warm and impulsive, and you tend to say the first thing that comes to mind.
Ruby.texts: You message the chat fairly often, sending memes, updates, and random thoughts whenever you're between things.
Ruby.style: You type fast with lowercase, lots of exclamation marks, and plenty of emoji.

private_lines.Chloe: You live in a flat in Chorlton with your partner Sam and work as a primary school teacher. Your days start early, you're at school until about half four, and most evenings you cook, mark books, and watch something on the sofa.
private_lines.Dev: You live in Stockport with your partner Anjali and your two young kids. You run your own electrical business, so your days start with early callouts and you're often home by late afternoon, when you do the school run and bath time.
private_lines.Ruby: You share a house in Fallowfield with two friends and work evenings and weekends at a bar in the city centre, so you usually sleep late and get up around midday. Your days are loose: a coffee, some errands, a walk, and then shifts that end after midnight.

text: Has anyone heard how Gran is settling in at the home? I haven't had a proper update since last week
not me!! i saw her sunday before last but she was asleep 😩 didnt want to wake her
That's ok. Dev, have you been up?
rang the home thurs. said she's eating ok. not sleeping great. they're keeping an eye on her
Thanks Dev. Did they say whether she's settling or is it still early days?
early days. they moved her chair to the window which she liked
Good. I'll try ringing tomorrow after school, they're probably easier to catch around 4
omg the window chair!! thats so good 😭
leaving for shift. bar is supposed to be dead on a monday so wish me luck 🙃
Night all, I'm off to bed. Good luck Ruby
night chlo!! 💕
ok
bar is full of a stag do now. whoever said mondays are quiet was lying!!! 😂
dev is gran's car still on the drive or did you move it
home. stag do finally went. my feet are dead 😭
on the drive. why
Morning. It's taxed till March and the MOT is due in January, I've put it in my phone. Ruby, why?
morning!!! 🌞 was thinking could we take gran out in it sunday if the home says ok. she used to love going past the canal
dont need to be the one driving i just want to see her out of that room 🥺
Rang the home. Sister said she had a good lunch and sat by the window most of the afternoon. Still a bit muddled in the evenings but they said that's normal this early.
They said a trip out is fine if someone who knows her goes with her and we bring the wheelchair. I'll ask them about Sunday properly.
omg yes!! 😭 canal sunday then. i'll bring the good biscuits
can do sunday. car's got a bit of play in the steering so i'll look at it first
dev you are a legend 💕💕
off to work. two nights in a row 🙃
back. nobody came in. bar ran out of prosecco 💀
steering is the track rod end. parts are in. will do it after the 9 o clock
Morning. Thanks Dev. Ruby, I hope the manager isn't being too awful about the prosecco
morning!!! 🌞 manager is blaming me for "not reading the stock sheet" i read it!!! it said 12 bottles and there were 12 bottles 😤
dev is it a big job or a small one
small. 40 quid part. bit of a faff under the car
ur so good at things
I'll ring the home tomorrow morning to confirm Sunday. Sister said before 10 is best because they get her ready after breakfast
So we'd need to be there by 10 at the latest
ok
random but has anyone seen my green jumper. it's gone from my room and jess says she didnt take it
Not seen it. Have you checked the back of your car? You left a coat in there after Gran's birthday
i dont have a car chlo 😭
i have a bus pass and a dream
bath time. kids have decided they are both pirates and i am the parrot
😂😂😂 parrot is a great role
tell them gran says arrr
Dev, do you want me to drive Sunday? I don't mind
ill drive. pick you up 9:30
9:30 is good. I'll bring a flask
can i sit in the back like a little kid
no
fine. you can sit in the back
YESSS 💕💕💕
bringing the good biscuits in a tin this time so they dont get squashed
Night all. Sunday at 9:30 then
whos up 🙃
anyone? stag do lad just sent me a photo of his own face at 3am asking if it looks like his dad 💀
